english.title: Driver of a goods vehicle fail to give name / address / insurance / plating certificate after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a plating certificate issued in respect of the vehicle and any trailer drawn by it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date see H325.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give **(..SPECIFY HIS/HER..) name and address to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant certificate of insurance and plating certificate in respect of **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE/A TRAILER /THE VEHICLE AND A TRAILER DRAWN BY IT..) when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd nwyddau wedi methu â rhoi enw/cyfeiriad/tystysgrif yswiriant/platio yn dilyn damwain ffordd/trosedd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(.. SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(.. SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau’n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd wrth ddefnyddio cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar ffordd, sef, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) ar gais swyddog heddlu, bu ichi fethu â rhoi eich enw a’ch cyfeiriad a chyflwyno y dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio o dan Ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 a thystysgrif platio a roddwyd ar gyfer y cerbyd ac unrhyw drelar a oedd yn caei ei dynnu ganddo
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd wrth ddefnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd â rhoi ei enw a’i gyfeiriad i swyddog heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, a methodd â chyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol a thystysgrif platio ar gyfer **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE/A TRAILER/THE VEHICLE AND A TRAILER DRAWN BY IT..), pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu cyn pen saith diwrnod.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 i Ddeddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
